_doc: Hybrid wall treatment (wings y+ 1-5, other walls 30-100). Detail zones re-solidified on a 1.25-1.5 mm grid where only real gaps (open along their mouths, deeper than the coarse wrap's offset) are reopened: wings, bargeboards, forward floor, floor edge, diffuser, wheel areas (geometry review 2026-11-17); slot refinement regions; post v2. MP4/5 (1989) replaces the MP4/4. Coarse meshes: check runs.
